  ret { ptr, ptr } %closure_env
}

define { ptr, ptr } @"scan_loop$direct"(ptr %0, { { ptr, i64 }, { i64, { { ptr, i64 }, ptr } } } %1, ptr %2, i64 %3) {

  %indirect_buf.0 = alloca { { ptr, i64 }, { i64, { { ptr, i64 }, ptr } } }, align 8
  call void @llvm.lifetime.start.p0(i64 48, ptr %indirect_buf.0)
  store { { ptr, i64 }, { i64, { { ptr, i64 }, ptr } } } %1, ptr %indirect_buf.0, align 8
  call void @"scan_loop$direct_mt"(ptr noalias nonnull sret({ ptr, ptr }) align 8 dereferenceable(16) %sret_buf, ptr nonnull align 8 dereferenceable(48) %indirect_buf.0, ptr %0, ptr %2, i64 %3)

  %sret_load = load { ptr, ptr }, ptr %sret_buf, align 8
  call void @llvm.lifetime.end.p0(i64 16, ptr %sret_buf)
  ret { ptr, ptr } %sret_load
}
